selection.summary: Refactoring to decouple deprecation warnings from Config and deprecate ui.enabled, based on delivered base evidence. Findings: (1) h15/h2 show Config embeds a Warnings []string field (h27) that prepare() populates during the deprecator scan (h28), coupling warnings with config data; Load returns (*Config, error) only (h15). (2) Existing deprecators (CacheConfig h5/h18, DatabaseConfig h20) emit messages formatted by deprecation.String() in h1, using v.IsSet/v.GetBool checks — cache.memory.enabled checks truthiness rather than explicit presence, while db.migrations.path correctly uses IsSet; ui.enabled triggers no deprecation because UIConfig (h10) implements only defaulter. (3) Callers of config.Load: cmd/flipt/main.go:162 (h3/h24) and internal/config tests (h0/h12/h17, calls at h23/h21). Planned repair: remove Config.Warnings, change Load to return (*Config, []string, error) collecting deprecation messages separately, make UIConfig implement deprecator with v.IsSet(\"ui.enabled\") guard so warnings fire only when the key is explicitly present, update main.go to log returned warnings, and update tests (removing cfg.Warnings expectations, handling the third return value). The final apply_edits batch against config_test.go failed with repository.stale-edit-source, so the test-file portion of the repair is NOT verified as applied; config.go, ui.go, and cmd/flipt/main.go edits were applied earlier (changed_paths confirmed), but no post-edit reads were available to verify final file state, and no tests were run. Handle the repair as partially applied/unverified.

native_export.selection_posture: Explicit terminal handles plus at most one presented, provenance-valid adjacent test read for a selected same-stem implementation source; native source projection and export unchanged.

sidecar.claim_ceiling: Confirmed delivery and declared final selection only; neither proves semantic use.

source_projection.claim_ceiling: Only exact unchanged source lines map to base coordinates. Changed/inserted lines receive no base-context credit.
